summary: A price index follows a fixed basket of what consumers actually buy.
realLife: The Consumer Price Index measures the average change over time in the prices consumers pay for a market basket of goods and services.
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Consumer Price Index Frequently Asked Questions: https://www.bls.gov/cpi/questions-and-answers.htm
inGame: the macro module's price records, read by the loading screen's progress step for the economy (loading-steps.economy).

turns.what: Prices fall for the basket and the index drops for a month.
turns.pulledBy: a price change in the macro model
turns.writesBack: a lower price record the step reads

turns.what: Groceries rise while rent holds, so the basket moves less than the grocery bill.
turns.pulledBy: a split between food and shelter prices
turns.writesBack: separate price records for each part of the basket
